purpose: Release qualification receipt for DeepSeek-V4-Flash and source qualification for the packaged GLM-5.2 profiles

implemented_contracts.ds4_graph_metadata: The C128A sparse-metadata buffer uses its physical graph capacity as the head stride.
implemented_contracts.ds4_sparse_topk: Sparse top-k consumes exactly the active row count and rejects stale trailing rows.
implemented_contracts.ds4_metadata_performance: GPU-native sparse metadata updates replace per-step host scalar extraction without changing checksums.
implemented_contracts.glm_sparse_prefill: Prefill preserves the sparse attention mask and exact row semantics required by GLM-5.2.
implemented_contracts.mrv2_state: Cached logits-processing state is reset for each request and cannot retain stale thinking state.
implemented_contracts.hybrid_kv_recovery: External KV load failures restore per-group block-table rows for heterogeneous attention caches.
implemented_contracts.persistent_kv: Native filesystem tiering and LMCache disk tiering both preserve exact results across complete process restarts.

upstream_vllm_main_audit.result: No additional DS4 or GLM runtime change is required. The commits after 203926c477 modify only ROCm CI configuration and its metadata test.

result: The immutable image passed the release suites and qualified DeepSeek-V4-Flash TP2/DCP1 fixed probabilistic DSpark K5, FULL CUDA graph execution, strict structured output, native filesystem KV restart replay, and LMCache disk restart replay.
limitations: GLM-5.2 EXL3 runtime files are rank-sliced for TP4 and reject TP2 by contract. GPUs 4 and 5 were unavailable for this qualification, so the required TP4 geometry was not executed.
GLM-5.2 NVFP4 requires TP8 and was not executed against this image.
The GLM-5.2 TP4 runtime evidence remains attached to Infernal Invocation r17 and is not claimed as r18 runtime evidence.
